node.statement: Apply the registered column-hilbert-inner-product-displays axiom at amplification n to Y,V in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}: Y^dagger dot V=<Y,V>*u_Q. Substituting V=Z dot X and multiplying both sides by the scalar 2 gives exactly Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)=<Y,Z dot X>*u_Q and 2*Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)=2*<Y,Z dot X>*u_Q.
